lessons.contentSummary: Customer → offer → delivery; interest vs paying demand

questions.prompt: Which statement is most DigProg-aligned for “What a business is”?

choices.text: Ship a small loop; learn from evidence; improve

questions.feedback: Evidence loops beat perfection theater.

choices.text: Do the stated practice / worksheet, then quiz

questions.prompt: What should you avoid while practicing “What a business is”?

choices.text: Treating praise/likes as proof of paying demand

questions.feedback: Interest is useful; purchases are stronger evidence.

choices.text: Re-read the objective and complete the smallest next action
Restart the whole course from Module 1
